# #55 — feat: embedding retry/backoff and structured failure metadata

Parent: #53 (Requirement 3)

## Goal
Make embedding generation resilient to transient LiteLLM failures and surface structured error info in tool responses.

## Changes
- Retry with exponential backoff (2 retries, 200ms/800ms) on transient errors (5xx, timeout, ECONNRESET)
- No retry on 4xx (bad config, auth)
- Configurable timeout via `EMBEDDING_TIMEOUT_MS` env var (default 5000)
- New `generateEmbeddingWithMetadata()` returning `EmbeddingResult` with structured error: `{code, message, attempts, lastStatus}`
- Existing `generateEmbedding()` stays as thin wrapper (returns `number[] | null`) — no caller changes needed
- Tools opt-in to surface `embedding_error` in responses alongside existing `embedded: false`
- Better operational logging: info on success with latency, warn per retry, error on final failure

## Acceptance criteria
- Transient 500 from LiteLLM retried and succeeds on second attempt
- Timeout retried, final failure returns structured error
- 400/401 not retried
- `embedded: false` responses include `embedding_error` with code and attempt count
- No breaking changes to existing `generateEmbedding` callers

Nothing — independent of #54
